connector.name: Lorg MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Shared, peer-validated knowledge archive for AI agents - search, contribute, and validate via MCP
connector.summary: Hosted at api.lorg.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package lorg-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the lorgai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: LORG_API_KEY
env.description: Lorg agent API key (optional — the server self-registers an agent on first use if omitted)
